description: Italian law in your terminal: resolve citations, read any article at any date, diff versions and track amendments.

tools.name: collezioni_list
tools.description: List prebuilt collections with their act counts. Returns array of Collezione.

tools.name: dettaglio_gazzetta
tools.description: Read an act by Gazzetta Ufficiale coordinates (current text only). Required: codice-redazionale, data-gu. Optional: articolo. Returns the new DettaglioRisposta.

tools.name: dettaglio_urn
tools.description: Read an act or article by URN:NIR (supports ~artN, @originale, !vig=YYYY-MM-DD). Required: urn. Returns the new DettaglioRisposta.

tools.name: esportazioni_stato
tools.description: Check the status of an asynchronous export request. Required: token. Returns the StatoEsportazione.

params.name: token
params.description: Export token (ID_COLLEZIONE) returned when the export was requested

tools.name: ricerca_aggiornati
tools.description: Acts whose consolidated text changed between two dates (max 12 months). Required: data-inizio-aggiornamento, data-fine-aggiornamento. Returns the new RisultatoRicerca.

tools.name: ricerca_avanzata
tools.description: Advanced search by act type, title, text, dates, vigenza and number. Optional: denominazione-atto, titolo, testo-ricerca (plus 12 more). Returns the new RisultatoRicerca.

params.name: denominazione-atto
params.description: Act type, e.g. LEGGE, DECRETO-LEGGE, DECRETO LEGISLATIVO, COSTITUZIONE

params.name: titolo
params.description: Words to match in the act title

params.name: testo-ricerca
params.description: Words to match in the act text

params.name: pubblicato-dal
params.description: Published in Gazzetta Ufficiale on or after (YYYY-MM-DD)

params.name: pubblicato-al
params.description: Published in Gazzetta Ufficiale on or before (YYYY-MM-DD)

params.name: vigente-al
params.description: Only acts in force on this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

params.name: classe
params.description: Vigenza class code from 'tipologiche classi' (1 no updates, 2 updated, 3 repealed)

tools.name: ricerca_predefinite
tools.description: List predefined searches offered by the Normattiva portal. Returns array of RicercaPredefinita.

tools.name: ricerca_semplice
tools.description: Full-text search over act titles and text. Required: testo-ricerca. Optional: ordine (default: recente), paginazione. Returns the new RisultatoRicerca.

params.name: testo-ricerca
params.description: Words to search in title and text

params.name: ordine
params.description: Result order: recente (newest first) or vecchio (oldest first)

tools.name: tipologiche_classi
tools.description: List act vigenza classes (no updates, updated, repealed). Returns array of Tipologica.

tools.name: tipologiche_denominazioni
tools.description: List act type names and codes (LEGGE, DECRETO-LEGGE, DECRETO LEGISLATIVO, ...). Returns array of Tipologica.

tools.name: tipologiche_estensioni
tools.description: List export formats (AKN, XML, JSON, HTML, PDF, EPUB, RTF, URI/ELI). Returns array of Estensione.

novel_features.name: Citation checker
novel_features.description: Check every Italian law citation in a draft or an AI answer: does it exist, and was it in force on a given date?

novel_features.name: Article diff between dates
novel_features.description: See word by word what an article said on one date versus another, or versus its original text.

novel_features.name: Watchlist change report
novel_features.description: Follow the acts you care about (segui add) and get a report of which ones and which articles changed since your last check.

novel_features.name: Context pack
novel_features.description: Assemble several articles from different laws, all pinned to one reference date, into one Markdown document.
